qualification: Sequential production WebGL2 samples on one Apple M4 Pro host. The document was visible and focused at the start of every retained sample, and visible at the end. A one-tree control before the matrix delivered approximately 120 draws/s. No builds or automated renderer tests ran during measurements. No ending control, low-detail result, winter performance sample or overview performance sample was retained because the browser approval service became unavailable. Draw counts and rAF delivery do not measure GPU execution time or certify presented frames. Synchronous render call timings are CPU/driver wall time. Results are workload-specific and are not maximum-throughput or cross-device claims. Samples precede the final square-spiral count-stability layout and reduced-motion default changes; source/build fingerprints identify the measured version. Renderer meshes and detail budgets are unchanged.

recipe.sourceState: uncommitted camera and measurement refinement over baseCommit
recipe.renderer: one production WebGL2 renderer per case; other Tree Lab animations paused
recipe.dataset: deterministic mixed five-species forest, exact instance counts
recipe.measurement: 2 second warmup then three 5 second 90 degree camera orbits, 500 ms idle before each orbit
recipe.metrics: rAF intervals; submitted onAfterRender draw count; synchronous render call wall time, not GPU elapsed time
recipe.view: shared forest canopy unless query view=overview
recipe.device: Apple M4 Pro through ANGLE Metal

supersedes.reason: Earlier samples were limited by host scheduling and used a different camera. They cannot be compared directly with this matrix.
